rationale: KVYO gapped up ~8% on no news catalyst, which makes the move difficult to contextualize directionally — without a fundamental driver, gap fades and gap continuations are roughly equiprobable. Price is consolidating tightly near the midpoint of today's range (70.7%) with very low 1-minute volume and ATR of only $0.105, offering insufficient reward-to-risk for a clean setup in either direction. The lack of a clear structural level to lean against and absence of news context make this a low-conviction environment where skipping preserves capital.
